A robber!

strings.zh: 你又是从哪冒出来的家伙？{NEWLINE}我想怎么处置我的精灵跟你无关。{CLEAR}少多管闲事！
strings.en: And where did you come from? What I do{NEWLINE}with my Pokémon is none of your{CLEAR}business.{SCROLL}Butt out!

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Please don’t assume Nidoran♀{NEWLINE}belongs to you now.{SCROLL}You have no right to decide its future.

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well, today this girl is butting{NEWLINE}in whether you like it or not!

strings.zh: 你这么不知死活的话,{NEWLINE}就让你尝尝我的厉害！
strings.en: If you’ve got that much of a death{NEWLINE}wish, I’ll show you what I can do!

strings.zh: 好家伙,{NEWLINE}居然栽在你这种人手里！
strings.en: Unbelievable. Beaten by someone like{NEWLINE}you!

strings.zh: 行吧,你要是喜欢这种{NEWLINE}垃圾个体值的尼多兰,{CLEAR}你就抱回家去跟它生蛋吧！
strings.en: Fine. If you like a Nidoran♀ with garbage{NEWLINE}IVs that much...{SCROLL}...take it home and breed with it{NEWLINE}yourself!

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我留住了尼多兰。{SCROLL}我除了会做柑果球,{NEWLINE}没什么能报答你的。{CLEAR}如果你想把采集的柑果做成球,{CLEAR}尽管来尼比市找我就好！
strings.en: Thank you for helping me keep Nidoran♀.{SCROLL}All I know how to do is make Apricorn{NEWLINE}Balls. I don’t have anything else to{CLEAR}repay you with.{SCROLL}If you want the Apricorns you collect{NEWLINE}made into balls, just come find me in{CLEAR}Pewter City!

strings.zh: 尼多兰『Ni……ran……{SCROLL}尼多兰点了点头。
strings.en: Nidoran♀: Ni... ran...{SCROLL}Nidoran♀ nodded.

strings.zh: 尼多兰！{NEWLINE}谢谢你选择留下来！
strings.en: Nidoran♀! Thank you for choosing to{NEWLINE}stay!

strings.zh: 我刚在尼比道馆锻炼完努力值,{NEWLINE}你愿意跟我来场对战帮我检验一下{CLEAR}努力值的加成效果吗？
strings.en: I just finished EV training at the{NEWLINE}Pewter Gym.{SCROLL}Will you battle me to help test how well{NEWLINE}my EVs are working?

strings.zh: 谢谢,请尽全力攻过来吧！
strings.en: Thanks! Come at me with everything{NEWLINE}you’ve got!

strings.zh: 虽然刚刚是我输了,{NEWLINE}但我能感觉到我的精灵的物防水平{CLEAR}已经有所提升了。{SCROLL}果然精灵能力值的强弱{NEWLINE}不是只由种族值决定的,{CLEAR}后天的努力值培养也非常重要。{SCROLL}关东地区的大多数道馆{NEWLINE}都设有锻炼努力值的陪练,{CLEAR}你如果想通过锻炼努力值{CLEAR}提升精灵能力,{CLEAR}找道馆里的陪练准没错。
strings.en: I lost just now, but I can feel my{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s Defense has gone up.{SCROLL}A Pokémon’s stats really aren’t decided{NEWLINE}by base stats alone. The EVs you train{CLEAR}afterward matter a lot too.{SCROLL}Most Gyms in Kanto have sparring{NEWLINE}partners for EV training.{SCROLL}If you want to raise your Pokémon’s{NEWLINE}stats with EV training, you can’t go{CLEAR}wrong with a Gym’s sparring partners.
